name_reason: Follows fd2_<domain>_<descriptor> convention (domain=save, descriptor=compute_checksum). No Ghidra address residue. Accurately reflects purpose: it computes the FD2.SAV integrity checksum by summing buffer bytes.
purpose: Compute the FD2.SAV integrity checksum by summing all buffer bytes except the trailing 4 (which hold the checksum field itself), returning the natural u32-wrap sum.
logic_summary: remaining = len - 4; checksum = 0; do { checksum += *pBuf; remaining--; pBuf++; } while (remaining != 0); return checksum. A do-while LODSB/LOOP-style byte sum over the first len-4 bytes. No overflow guard (relies on natural u32 wraparound). do-while means len <= 4 underflows the counter, so callers must pass len > 4 (FD2.SAV uses len = 0x59CB).

params.name: pBuf
params.semantics: Pointer to the byte buffer to checksum (the decrypted FD2.SAV image at the call sites).
params.reason: Descriptive byte-buffer pointer name matching its use as the LODSB source; no address residue.

params.name: len
params.semantics: Total buffer length including the 4 trailing checksum bytes; the sum loop runs over len-4 bytes.
params.reason: Accurate length descriptor matching body use (remaining = len - 4); no address residue.

returns.semantics: The natural u32-wrap byte sum over buf[0..len-5]; stored by callers into the checksum field at buf+0x59C7 (write path) or compared against it (validate path).

notes: Verified against caller fd2_save_current_state_to_slot @ 0x30012: checksum = fd2_save_compute_checksum(pBuf, 0x59CB) then *(uint*)(pBuf+0x59C7) = checksum, confirming the 4 trailing bytes (0x59C7..0x59CA) are the checksum field and the sum covers bytes 0..0x59C6. Existing src comment (save.c lines 67-79) and Ghidra plate are both accurate, ASCII-clean, and mutually consistent; no edit needed. Only this shard is staged.
